regions.label: Office-style ribbon tab strip: FILE (blue backstage trigger), HOME, EDIT, ACCOUNT; username with cat avatar at right
HOME ribbon panel with grouped large-icon commands: Table (New Table, Save), Export (Export, Share), Page (700px, 1500px, 100%, grid/fit toggles), Feedback
Grey welcome screen: 'Dbdesigner.id / Joy your design' title and four link lists: Recent, Help, New Feature, News

evidence.note: Persistent ribbon frame with tabs, command groups and user identity at top-right above content region
Ribbon tabs; HOME active with white tab and blue text; verified live that EDIT switches the ribbon panel (empty)
FILE trigger; live it opens a full-height left backstage panel (New/Open/Properties/Account/Logout + Open project list with search) over a grey scrim. Panel itself not in the capture.

patterns.rationale: Only the trigger is in the capture; the backstage panel was verified on the live page.

evidence.note: Welcome/start screen shown in place of the diagram canvas when no diagram is loaded (live shows 'Data not found' toast); offers recent designs, help and news links

patterns.rationale: Could be read as a start/home screen rather than an empty state of the canvas; the cause is inferred from live behavior.

evidence.note: On the live page an error toast 'Data not found' appears top-centre on load; it is not visible in the capture

patterns.rationale: Seen only on the live page, not in the captured screenshot (likely auto-dismissed or timing).

evidence.note: Page size/zoom/grid controls hint at a diagram canvas, but no canvas is rendered in the capture

patterns.rationale: The editor canvas is not shown; only the start screen.

structure.layout: desktop web app: Office-style ribbon (tab strip + grouped icon toolbar) above a full-width grey content area showing a two-column welcome page of link lists

aesthetics.typography: 'Chinese Quote' (Ant Design font stack, renders as system sans/Helvetica-like) for ribbon labels, section labels and links; Segoe UI (falls back to Open Sans-like) for the page title and tagline
aesthetics.typeScale: Title 30px/400, tagline 24px/300, section labels 20px/400, links 14px/400, ribbon tab and button labels 11px, group captions 10px; low weight contrast, size-driven hierarchy

notes: Mimics the Microsoft Office ribbon closely: blue FILE tab (#0072c6) as backstage trigger, HOME tab raised white with blue text, large dark-grey filled icons (table grid, SD card save, paper plane export, share nodes) with 11px captions, and grey group caption bar (Table/Export/Page/Feedback) along the ribbon bottom; the Feedback icon is a red speech bubble. Content area is flat #f1f1f1 with plain Ant-blue (#1890ff) text links and a 'New' word highlighted in a solid blue selection-like box. Emoji 😎😎😎 used in the tagline. No rounded corners or shadows anywhere. Live page shows a 'Data not found' Ant-style error toast on load and a backstage left panel with recent projects list (not in capture).
